summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called AZD6234 in adults who have type 2 diabetes and are overweight or have obesity. Type 2 diabetes is a condition where the body has trouble managing its blood sugar levels. Researchers want to see how the study drug affects body weight compared to a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the medicine. Participants will receive either the study drug or a placebo during the study.
